DIGICHAT_EMBED_TENANTS_note: OVERLAY, not the registry. The digichat registry is composed at apply time from the host secret store: python3 scripts/digichat_tenant_registry.py compose --live-from <host-store-file> --overlay infra/digichat-release/DIG-4488-occ-tenant-overlay.json. This file carries no token and no mcp rows: the OCC token is a client secret and lives only in the host secret store. Never write this file to the worker secret. This overlay carries the OCC tenant alone: it sets no corpus routing. It sets a catalog policy (price cap, presets, full list) and no raw model id list, so the composed registry keeps the live OCC corpus routing and serves the curated picker.
